tasks.short: Maintain actual wellness schedules, service records and reports

steps.what: Read and reconcile actual wellness schedules, session records, attendance and service transactions and capture selected reporting fields and definitions
inputs: Actual existing schedules and session and booking records
Existing wellness booking and service-record system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
Actual periodic report requirements
outputs: Actual verified selected source records, reporting period, mappings and explicit count definitions with unresolved gaps

steps.what: Import exact selected schedule and actual service-record fields into the native periodic report draft
inputs: Actual verified records and explicit mappings captured in s1
outputs: Draft source-linked report fields with missing and mismatched records exposed

steps.what: Calculate exact selected session, attendance and service totals from the actual records using explicit period and count definitions
inputs: Actual imported records from s2
Explicit selected definitions from s1
outputs: Draft reproducible report totals with actual record reconciliation

steps.what: Write the actual report explanation and check the entire completed schedule-and-service report against real sessions, records, totals and uncertainty
inputs: Actual report fields and totals from s2-s3
Original actual session records and reporting requirement
outputs: Complete actual service report with human explanation and ordinary source checks

steps.what: Save the actual completed report in the same system
inputs: Actual complete report from s4
outputs: Saved actual wellness schedule-and-service report

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} record imports and explicit report totals, using {BI} only if the native report cannot express them. Keep actual schedule and session reconciliation and complete {DOCS} report writing and checking human; ordinary save is ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual periodic report can repeat existing schedule and session fields and fixed totals.
tasks.enabler_now: Native booking and service records can populate exact selected report fields and calculations.
tasks.still_hard: A booking does not prove attendance or that the service actually occurred.
tasks.human_edge: Reconcile actual delivered services and explain missing or inconsistent records.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 including employee consultation if staff-linked records change

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native booking and service systems can populate explicit report fields and totals while actual attendance and service reconciliation remain human.

assumptions: This representative episode maintains records through an actual periodic schedule-and-service report with manually repeated fields and totals. Shares are unmeasured and independent of the supplied prior; scheduling changes have a different actual workflow.

Staff produce actual bookings and session records as existing baseline work. The coordinator reads, verifies, resolves gaps and captures every selected reporting field and definition in s1. No free clean attendance feed is assumed or inferred from a booking.
Try native reports first. Existing imports, totals and runtime are baseline and earn no new gain. Missing and inconsistent records remain exposed for retained human resolution.
s4 includes the actual report and ordinary source checking, not self-approval. Same-system save is ungated, negligible and earns no gain; 1 is the schema's minimum positive share.
No participant-health inference, staff score, booking alteration, report send or new approval ceremony is performed.
unknowns: Actual native reporting coverage and source-record quality
research_questions: Which exact fields and totals are manually rebuilt in an actual service report?

already_counted.description: Actual schedule and service-source reconciliation and full report writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings and definitions and review missing-session exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50; gross saving=50 from actual repeated source transfer and totals. Deduct 4 incremental hours once for net 46. Actual reconciliation and report explanation stay human; save has no gate or saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop actual fitness and wellness programmes or services

steps.what: Gather and evaluate actual participant needs, service evidence, staff expertise, facilities and resource constraints
inputs: Actual participant and staff information and existing service records
Existing wellness programme system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual verified needs and resources with captured source fields and unresolved questions

steps.what: Develop the actual programme purpose, activities, staffing, accessibility and delivery approach with relevant specialists
inputs: Actual needs and constraints from s1 and specialist input
outputs: Human-selected programme design and captured specific activities and resources

steps.what: Fill exact selected activity, staffing and resource fields into the native programme planning template
inputs: Actual selected design fields captured in s2
Actual verified source fields from s1
outputs: Draft actual programme structure with exact selected fields

steps.what: Write the actual programme explanation and check the entire completed design for needs, activities, staffing, feasibility and limits
inputs: Actual plan structure from s3, original needs and human programme choices
outputs: Complete actual programme development document with human explanation and ordinary checks

steps.what: Save the actual completed programme development document in the same system
inputs: Actual completed document from s4
outputs: Saved actual programme design with its actual draft status

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} programme fields from actual design decisions and verified {OPS_SYSTEM} records. Keep needs assessment, specialist discussion, service design and actual complete-document writing and checking human, followed by an ungated ordinary save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual programme designs can repeat selected activity and resource fields after the programme choices exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Native programme templates can reproduce exact selected planning fields.
tasks.still_hard: A feasible and useful wellness service requires real participant needs and specialist knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: Choose an appropriate service and understand its practical limits.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: programme templates can reuse exact selected resource and activity fields without designing a suitable fitness or wellness service.

assumptions: This conditional programme-development episode has an actual written design and repeated fields. Shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the supplied prior.

The coordinator collects actual participant and staff evidence and captures selected source fields in s1, then produces and captures all programme choices with specialists in s2. No free needs analysis, staffing plan or medical prescription is assumed.

Native templates are tried first. Existing field reuse is baseline and earns no new gain. Missing information returns to retained consultation; no model decides health suitability or creates evidence.
s4 is actual programme writing and ordinary checking, not a self-approval step. Same-system save is ungated, negligible and earns no gain, with 1 the schema minimum.

This produces an actual programme draft, not approval of the author's own programme. Actual independent offering approval is distinct under 15552; no launch, booking change, expenditure or notice is silently performed.
unknowns: Actual programme template and scope of coordinator design work
research_questions: Which actual selected programme fields are manually repeated after the design choices are made?

already_counted.description: Actual needs consultation, programme design and complete substantive document writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain exact programme fields and review source and resource-version exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving=20 from actual repeated plan fields. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 17. Service design and ungated same-system save remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate and approve actual new programme or service offerings

steps.what: Read the actual completed new-offering proposal prepared by service staff and verify its aims, scope and sources
inputs: Actual completed staff-authored programme or service proposal
Existing programme approval and service system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Understood actual proposal version, evidence and unresolved source issues

steps.what: Evaluate actual demand, wellbeing purpose, staff and facility requirements and capture selected cost, revenue and capacity inputs and explicit comparison rules
inputs: Actual proposal and sources from s1
Actual available resource and price evidence
outputs: Human assessment and actual captured verified comparison inputs and rules

steps.what: Calculate exact selected cost, revenue and capacity comparisons using the verified inputs and explicit rules
inputs: Actual verified selected inputs and comparison rules captured in s2
outputs: Draft reproducible offering comparisons with sources and assumptions visible

steps.what: Review the entire completed staff proposal and comparison evidence and decide whether this exact offering version meets the actual approval criteria and delegated authority
inputs: Complete staff-authored proposal from s1
Actual comparison evidence from s2-s3 and existing approval criteria
outputs: Human approval or refusal of the exact completed proposal version, with reasons and authority limits

steps.what: Record the actual approval or refusal of the exact completed staff-authored offering proposal in the existing approval workflow
inputs: Exact proposal and actual approval or refusal decided in s4
outputs: Actual offering approval decision recorded with exact proposal version

steps.what: Write the actual decision explanation and check its accuracy against the proposal and recorded decision
inputs: Actual decision from s4-s5 and original proposal evidence
outputs: Actual completed decision explanation with ordinary accuracy checking

steps.what: Save the actual completed decision explanation in the same document system
inputs: Actual completed explanation from s6
outputs: Saved actual decision explanation

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} exact offering comparisons from actual inputs verified by the coordinator. Keep actual evaluation and approval of the completed staff-authored proposal human; ordinary {DOCS} decision-explanation writing and save remain separate from that genuine approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual offering evaluation can repeat fixed cost, revenue and capacity arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native comparison fields can reproduce explicit selected calculations with visible inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Demand, service value and practical viability require judgement beyond calculated margins.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether the actual offering deserves approval and explain the reasons.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit cost and capacity calculations can support offering evaluation without deciding whether a completed programme proposal should be approved.

assumptions: This conditional episode is the statement's actual approval branch: the coordinator evaluates a completed proposal authored by other service staff and has existing delegated approval authority. It is not approval of the coordinator's own programme under 15562. Shares are unmeasured and independent of the supplied prior.

Original staff proposal production remains baseline labour and is not claimed as focal saving or transferred free new work. The coordinator actually reads it in s1 and verifies and captures all comparison inputs and rules in s2.

Use native calculations first; existing totals and runtime are baseline. Missing prices, unsupported demand or unclear authority stop the affected calculation or approval for retained resolution, not a model-inferred outcome.

The completed exact proposal exists before the genuine approval in s4, and changed proposal content invalidates its reference for s5. This is an actual offering decision, not a newly invented approval ceremony.

All actual decision explanation and ordinary accuracy checking remain in s6. Its same-system save has no self-gate and no saving; 1 is the minimum schema allocation. No service launch, payment, staffing change or notification is silently performed.
unknowns: Actual approval delegation and manual comparison effort
research_questions: Does an observed offering approval review an independently authored completed proposal, and which arithmetic remains manual?

already_counted.description: Actual proposal reading, evaluation, genuine final-proposal approval and decision explanation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain explicit comparison rules and verify source and unit exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed staff-authored offering proposal reviewed and approved or refused in s4 within actual delegated authority; any proposal change invalidates it.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving=20 from actual manual comparison arithmetic. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 17. Genuine offering approval and ordinary ungated explanation save remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Oversee actual fitness facilities and equipment for safety and cleanliness

steps.what: Inspect actual fitness or recreation facilities and equipment for cleanliness, condition and observed safety concerns
inputs: Actual facility and equipment
Existing facility inspection and issue system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual captured inspection observations and selected facility and equipment identifiers

steps.what: Oversee actual housekeeping and maintenance follow-up through direct discussion with staff and assess unresolved facility concerns
inputs: Actual observations from s1 and actual staff work and questions
outputs: Actual human oversight, clarified responsibilities and unresolved condition concerns

steps.what: Write the actual existing inspection or fault entry and check its meaning against real observations, reusing exact facility and equipment fields
inputs: Actual observed and captured conditions and identifiers from s1
Actual follow-up information from s2
outputs: Complete actual condition entry with ordinary accuracy checks and real unresolved status

steps.what: Save the actual completed inspection or fault entry in the same system
inputs: Actual completed entry from s3
outputs: Saved actual facility condition record

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} exact facility and equipment fields in the actual existing inspection record. Keep physical inspection, staff oversight, condition judgement and substantive record writing human, with an ungated ordinary save.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual facility entry can repeat identifiers already selected during inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native inspection forms can reuse exact facility and equipment fields.
tasks.still_hard: A recorded cleaning or repair request does not establish that the actual facility is safe and clean.
tasks.human_edge: Observe real conditions and follow up on staff work and unresolved faults.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 including employee consultation if staff-linked records change

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native inspection forms can reuse equipment identifiers while direct condition checks, staff oversight and substantive fault records remain human.

assumptions: This representative facility oversight episode actually includes an existing condition entry. Shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the prompt prior; do not invent records after every informal staff discussion.

The coordinator actually observes and captures condition and identifiers in s1 and follows up with real staff in s2. No clean defect feed, inferred safety status or free housekeeping is assumed; staff physical work remains unchanged baseline labour.
Only exact fixed fields reduce s3. Actual wording and ordinary source checks remain; native fields already present are baseline and earn no new gain.

There is no self-approval. Same-system save is ungated, negligible and earns no saving, with 1 the schema minimum. No automatic repair, closure, reopening, equipment control or hidden work-order send occurs.

Existing urgent facility controls and safety responses retain their actual effort and priority. If an observed episode includes a separate notice or physical action, represent its genuine authority and separate step rather than hiding it in the record.
unknowns: Actual condition-record requirement and facility follow-up procedure
research_questions: What actual written entry follows an observed facility inspection, separately from direct staff oversight?

already_counted.description: Actual physical inspection, staff oversight and substantive condition-entry writing and checking remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=98.1; gross saving=1.9 from exact identifiers. Deduct 1 incremental hour once for net 0.9. Physical oversight and ordinary ungated save remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
